_confirmMechanismNote: HOW A CONFIRMATION CLICK IS OBSERVED, and the single switch for the cutover. `double_opt_in`: the Klaviyo list is double opt-in, Klaviyo only adds a profile once the opt-in link is clicked, so membership of the subscribed set IS the confirmation. `flow_link`: the list is SINGLE opt-in, entrants are subscribed on form submit, and a branded flow email carries the confirmation link (update_property_link writes gv_confirmed). Under flow_link, subscription proves NOTHING — reading it as confirmation pays the +2 to every submitter and inflates every §5 referral rung with it. lib/giveaway/reconcile.js resolveMechanism() is the only reader; an unrecognised value throws rather than defaulting, because the two branches disagree about every entrant on the list at once. FLIPPING THIS IS HALF THE CUTOVER — the Klaviyo list opt-in process must be changed in the UI in the same maintenance window, and in this order: set the list to single opt-in FIRST, then flip this key. The reverse order leaves a window where entrants are on a double-opt-in list while the code has stopped believing subscription means anything, which stalls every +2 until the flip completes. See docs/giveaway-confirm-cutover.md.

disqualifiedEntryWindows.reason: Automated entry wave. 2,948 unengaged base entries in the final three hours of the Entry Period.

_disqualifiedEntryWindowsNote: SECTION 5 DISQUALIFICATION, applied by lib/giveaway/draw-snapshot.js at snapshot time. Rules §5: "Sponsor reserves the right to disqualify any entry it reasonably believes to be fraudulent, automated, or otherwise made in violation of these Official Rules." An entry stamped inside a window is disqualified ONLY IF the entrant shows no act a script does not perform — no confirmation click, no survey, no Instagram post, no upload, no credited referral. THE WINDOW IS DOING THE ACCUSING, so it fails open twice: an unparseable gv_entered_at is never disqualified, and any engagement rescues. Boundaries are inclusive-from, exclusive-to, and were read off the nginx per-minute request rate rather than rounded: onset 03:59Z (10 requests in that minute against 54 in the preceding 3h59m), last request 06:49Z, so the wave stopped 11 minutes BEFORE the 06:59:59Z close and the final ten minutes of genuine entries are untouched. WHY NOT AN EMAIL-PATTERN RULE: measured, and rejected — the strongest single feature was the mail domain at 65.5% of the suspect cohort against 2.1% of the known-good one, nowhere near the recall needed to disqualify on. The user agent, where the real proof is (5,920 of 5,930 requests on ONE string across 2,792 IPs; 3 distinct agents against 70 over the preceding five days), is forwarded to Meta's CAPI by agents/dashboard/routes/giveaway.js and never persisted on a profile, so it cannot be joined per entrant. Measured effect: 2,956 entrants in window, 8 exempt (4 confirmed, 4 engaged) retaining 40 entries, 2,948 disqualified holding exactly ONE entry each — which is itself corroboration, since real entrants accumulate rungs. Pool 7,367/22,803 -> 4,419/19,855; 12.9% of tickets removed. Zero of the 2,948 named a referrer, so §6's referral prize and every real entrant's referral credits are untouched. DO NOT widen a window without re-measuring the collateral: every entry removed here is a real person's odds if the accusation is wrong.
_drawPoolNote: OPERATOR DETERMINATION 2026-08-22, made because the published rules contradict themselves and the draw is not built yet. §4 and §5 grant one base entry for submitting the form ('Base entry — submitting the entry form: 1 entry'), and §8 draws 'from all eligible entries received during the Entry Period'. But §12 says 'Sponsor will use a snapshot of confirmed entrants taken at the close of the Entry Period to conduct the drawing' — which, read literally, excludes everyone who never clicked the opt-in link. Both cannot operate. The determination is that an UNCONFIRMED entrant IS in the draw, holding whatever entries §5 grants them (base 1, plus any referral bonus §5 pays onto their entry). Reasons: §4/§5 are the sections that tell an entrant what they get and they promise it explicitly; ambiguity in a consumer promotion is construed against the drafter; and excluding people who were told they had an entry is the reading most likely to draw a complaint. §12's heading is 'Unsubscribing Does Not Forfeit Your Entry' — its subject is unsubscribers, and 'confirmed entrants' there describes the common case rather than defining an exclusion. Scale when decided: 77 confirmed holding 302 entries, 206 unconfirmed holding 1 each — unconfirmed would be ~40% of a 508-entry pool, so this is not a rounding decision. SEPARATE AND UNAFFECTED: §6's referral PRIZE still requires the named referrer to be 'themselves a confirmed entrant', which is an explicit condition with no counterpart contradiction — an unconfirmed referrer never wins the second prize. Whoever builds the draw must honour this flag; do not re-derive the pool from the Klaviyo list, which only ever contains confirmed entrants. See docs/giveaway-referral-lessons.md.
_datesNote: PACIFIC TIME (-07:00 = PDT, which is what August and September are on) and the single source of truth for timing. The deadline campaigns (05-reminder, 06-final-call) are computed from entryClosesAt by lib/giveaway/nurture-schedule.js, and close-entry-period.mjs disables the nurture flow the morning after it. The same dates appear in prose in data/giveaway/official-rules.html and in the 06-final-call preheader — change all three together. Entry OPEN date moved 2026-08-14: Aug 15 -> Aug 18 to match the ad launch. TIMEZONE moved 2026-08-20: the config stamped -06:00 and called it 'store-local' while the published rules said 'CT' (-05:00 in September), so the two named closing instants an hour apart; the operator's decision is that the giveaway runs on PACIFIC, so BOTH were wrong and both were corrected. Calendar dates did not move — entries still close September 14, 2026 and the draw is still September 16, 2026 — and the deadline campaign sendAt values below are unchanged, because campaignSchedule() does its arithmetic on the literal YYYY-MM-DD and never on the offset. If you change the offset again, re-check the server cron for close-entry-period.mjs: it is a UTC-clock cron and does NOT follow this field.
_metaPixelNote: Real Skin Care pixel, installed via the Shopify Facebook & Instagram sales channel with Maximum data sharing (Pixel + advanced matching + Conversions API). Asserted by scripts/giveaway/verify-launch.mjs.
_provisionalCostPerEntryNote: A PLACEHOLDER, to be replaced by measurement — not a finding. The spend gate compares cost per entry against what a NEW entrant is measurably worth, but no entrant is 30 days old until mid-September, so without this the gate can only say 'not measurable yet' for the whole entry window while $30/day goes out. $2.50 is the figure the adopted paid-acquisition tactics already model against ($30/day ≈ 84 entries/week, which is what puts one consolidated ad set over Meta's ~50-conversion learning threshold); it is chosen for consistency with that arithmetic, not derived from RSC data. Sanity check on how aggressive it is: at $2.50/entry, breaking even on the FIRST purchase needs roughly an 8% entrant-to-purchase rate against the $50.46 trailing-90d AOV at ~60% gross margin. That is a high bar for a giveaway list, so expect the payoff to come from repeat purchase and LTV rather than first order — and expect to lower this number once real data lands. evaluateSpendGate uses measured value the moment one 30-day window closes and ignores this entirely from then on; it labels every verdict built on this number 'provisional' in the report line.
_killThresholdNote: OPERATOR DECISION 2026-08-22, pre-committed BEFORE the data arrives so the call is made against a stated condition rather than against how the campaign feels on a given morning. If fewer than 1.5% of NEW confirmed entrants place an order within 30 days of entering, the giveaway is buying sweepstakes entrants rather than customers and the campaign stops. Where 1.5% comes from: at the cost per confirmed entrant the campaign was running at when this was set (~$0.90, falling), one $50.46 order — the trailing-90d AOV — pays for roughly 56 confirmed entrants, so ~1.8% breaks even on REVENUE and 1.5% is the round number just under it. It is deliberately a revenue-breakeven floor, not a margin-breakeven one (~3.7% at 60% gross margin): a first order from a new customer is an acquisition, and the payoff is meant to come from repeat purchase, so requiring the first order to cover margin too would kill a campaign that is working as intended. NEW SEGMENT ONLY — an existing customer who enters and buys would have repurchased anyway at the ~18-22.5% baseline, so blending them measures retention and calls it acquisition. lib/giveaway/paid-readout.js refuses to return a kill verdict on fewer than 100 matured entrants, because at a 1.5% floor a smaller sample cannot tell 'does not convert' from 'has not converted yet'. Revisit once one 30-day window closes (mid-September 2026) and real entry->purchase data replaces the arithmetic above.
_metaCampaignNote: Soap Giveaway 2026-09 | Leads | US — objective OUTCOME_LEADS. Spend is read from this campaign by lib/giveaway/meta-spend.js for the daily spend gate. Recorded explicitly rather than discovered by name each run: four ad accounts exist on this token and name-matching would silently pick the wrong one if the campaign is ever renamed or duplicated.
_confirmedSegmentNote: Giveaway 2026-09 — Confirmed. Built 2026-08-24 via POST /segments/ as ONE condition_group holding TWO conditions: gv_confirmed_at is-set OR gv_confirmed equals the STRING "true". Both must live in the SAME group — Klaviyo combines condition_groups with AND and conditions WITHIN a group with OR, which is the inverse of what the nesting reads like, and splitting them would match only profiles carrying both. Both spellings are needed: gv_confirmed is what update_property_link writes the instant someone clicks, and gv_confirmed_at is the durable stamp the reconciler writes on its next run — a segment on the stamp alone would hold a confirmer out of the nurture flow until the 08:30 UTC reconcile, up to 24h later. Verified at creation against the list: 213 members, 213 in the segment, 0 missing and 0 extra. This API revision (2025-07-15) will not return a segment definition, so re-verify by MEMBERSHIP rather than by reading it back.
_unconfirmedSegmentNote: Giveaway 2026-09 — Entered, not confirmed. The NEGATION of confirmedSegmentId, and it has to be spelled as three separate condition_groups (gv_entrant is-set / gv_confirmed_at not-set / gv_confirmed not-set) because Klaviyo ANDs groups and ORs within a group — the confirmed segment needs its two clauses in ONE group, this one needs its three in THREE. The existence operator is "not-set", NOT "is-not-set" (a 400: An invalid field type was passed in) and there is no negated flag on ExistenceFilter. Verified at creation: 533 members, 0 of them already confirmed. Used as the audience for confirm-reminder campaigns; it re-evaluates continuously, so anyone who confirms before a send drops out on their own.
_confirmReminderNote: SENT 2026-08-25 14:00 UTC (the runbook long said DRAFT; it was scheduled by the operator and went). Reuses confirm-request template VxJnPd so it inherits that template's content gates and its update_property_link button. Measured: 33 of 487 delivered clicked, and a click IS a confirmation on flow_link, so 6.8% is the recovery rate any future reminder must be sized from. The 1-in-487 spam complaint (0.21%) is the number that actually governs whether another is safe — above Google/Yahoo's 0.1% target, below the 0.3% enforcement line.
_offerEngagedSegmentNote: Giveaway 2026-09 — Engaged (offer audience). Built 2026-09-17 as TWO condition_groups: group 1 is profile-group-membership on Y2ukbE (is_member true), group 2 holds Opened Email (VxU2a7) OR Clicked Email (WMW7pm) with count > 0 after 2026-08-01. Groups are ANDed and conditions within a group ORed, which is the inverse of what the nesting reads like. Verified by MEMBERSHIP, not by profile_count (this revision will not return a definition and reported no count): 2,457 members / 1,920 mailable / 537 suppressed, an EXACT match to an independent sweep of the Opened+Clicked event streams intersected with list membership. TWO API SHAPE TRAPS, both 400s: timeframe_filter is a StaticDateFilter and takes `date`, NOT `value`; and profile-group-membership requires `is_member`, with no membership_operator field. THE SEGMENT READ 0 MEMBERS FOR SEVERAL MINUTES AFTER CREATION — a new segment does not materialise immediately, so anything that re-points a campaign at one must count membership first and refuse below a floor (assertAudienceViable, floor 1000). Re-pointing during that window hands the campaign an empty audience and it sends to NOBODY at its scheduled time, reporting zero recipients as though that were the answer. The date bound is deliberately STATIC rather than rolling, so the Sep 19 and Sep 23 sends measure one fixed cohort; it has no upper bound, so anyone who opens send 11 is still engaged for send 12.
_offerExclusionNote: Giveaway 2026-09 — Drawn winners (offer exclusion). A STATIC list, excluded from all three offerCampaigns on 2026-09-12 by scripts/giveaway/exclude-drawn-winners.mjs --setup --apply (each campaign reverted, audiences edited, requeued; all three read back Scheduled with the list excluded and send times unchanged). Every offer send targets the whole entrant list Y2ukbE and the draw-day one opens 'We drew the winner. It wasn't you.', so without it the winner and the referral-prize winner are told they lost three hours after being told they won. It is EMPTY until the draw: `exclude-drawn-winners.mjs --winners --apply` adds them from data/giveaway/draw-result.json, and must run before 15:00 PT Sep 16. A list rather than a property segment because membership is immediate and verifiable; adding a profile to a list grants no consent.
_confirmReminderNote2: Reminder #2, built by scripts/giveaway/send-confirm-reminder.mjs. Audience is X7atwC MINUS exclusion segment YuYRCd (created before 2026-08-25T14:00:01Z = already reminded, OR created in the last 48h = confirm flow still working, OR gv_test = our own inboxes). Set subtraction rather than a rebuilt segment because profile-group-membership takes LISTS not segments, and restating X7atwC's confirmed logic would put a second copy of a rule that lives in exactly one place. 1,174 due; projected ~80 confirmations, ~10 unsubscribes, ~2 complaints from reminder #1's own rates. SENT 2026-09-05 21:59 UTC. Measured: 22 of 896 delivered confirmed (2.46%) against reminder #1's 6.78% — each reminder mails a colder cohort. 3 spam complaints = 0.335%, ABOVE the 0.3% Google/Yahoo enforcement line (#1 was 0.205%). Confirmed segment moved 1820 -> 1847. A third reminder is refused by scripts/giveaway/send-confirm-reminder.mjs on that complaint rate and needs --accept-complaint-risk; it is a store-wide deliverability decision, not a giveaway one.
